subject: Finova - sudden throughput & p99 spike after quant profile update
messages:
From: Anya Petrov <anya@finova.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com
Cc: Carlos Ruiz <c.ruiz@finova.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Unexpected p99/throughput regression after v2.1/quant profile

Hi Laura,

We rolled the model upgrade you recommended (model v2.1 with Q-Profile v3) into our production inference pool at ~02:00 UTC this morning. Within 30 minutes we started seeing: 
- p99 generation latency jump from ~220ms to ~920ms
- 15% increase in JSON parse errors emitted from the runtime and a ~12% drop in requests/s.
- Overall throughput oscillating (bursts then long tails) causing backpressure into our upstream API.

Attached are the runtime error snippets and a p99 plot for the first 4 hours (finova_error_log_0429.txt, p99_plots_q1.png). We have traffic redirected to the Redwood-hosted endpoint for this path (customer-facing).

This is causing visible user impact (retry loops and timeouts). Can you please escalate immediately — we need a mitigation plan (rollback, emergency profile tune, or routing to previous variant).

Thanks,
Anya Petrov
Sr. Engineering Manager, Platform
Finova

Anya / Carlos — thanks again for the call. Recap and actions we executed during the 09:00 PT troubleshooting session: 

What we saw:
- p99 jumped to ~920ms across your production keyspace after Q-Profile v3 application; KV cache miss rate rose ~38% corresponding to longer per-request compute.
- A handful of softmax/float exceptions correlated with sequence lengths >512.

Immediate mitigations performed:
- We initiated a targeted rollback to Q-Profile v2 for your customer-facing model variant at 09:12 PT; rollback completed at 09:24 PT. Preliminary telemetry shows p99 trending back toward baseline (~240ms) and requests/s recovering to expected levels.
- We enabled a temporary routing rule to send traffic to the previously-pinned replica pool for additional headroom.

Next steps / owner list:
- Marcus: deep-profile run across sequence length buckets >512 and produce a recommended tuning doc (ETA 48 hours).
- Stephanie: coordinate an eval run with Finova's key testset and produce regression checks (ETA 72 hours).
- Laura: coordinate SLA/credits conversation (Rafael supporting) and set a 1-week follow-up with execs.

Files shared: finova_error_log_0429.txt; p99_plots_q1.png; runbook_emergency_rollback.md

We will keep the rollback in place until Marcus publishes a safe re-tune and we validate with Finova's test traffic. Thanks for the quick coordination — we take this seriously.
